popCulture.title: Ocypete
popCulture.description: Swift-wing among the Harpies — Ocypete outflies the Boreads until exhaustion lands her on an ocean isle.

popCulture.title: Harpy
popCulture.description: The bird-maiden trio remains the classical image of divine punishment delivered on the wing.

popCulture.title: Jason and the Argonauts
popCulture.creator: Don Chaffey / Ray Harryhausen
popCulture.description: The film's Harpies sequence keeps Ocypete's kind in the Argonaut vocabulary of modern fantasy cinema.
